clips.title: The story
paras: Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith stationed along the snowy roadway leading from Coldridge Pass toward Kharanos. He maintains a busy shooting range and equips local hunters and mountaineers with firearms and ammunition.

Set up at a small campsite between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos, Hegnar Rumbleshot caters to dwarven marksmen, travelers, and the local militia. His camp features a popular shooting range where mountain folk hone their aim against the wild beasts prowling Dun Morogh. Supplying so many eager shooters means Hegnar burns through munitions at a brisk pace, leaving him perpetually reliant on fresh shipments of ammunition from his supplier, the dwarf engineer Loslor Rudge.
